//: SCP-087 SNIPPETS.  Snippets give the descent varied prose over repeated firing instead of the same line every time.  They are referenced with { "u_message": "<category>", "snippet": true }.
//2: DELIBERATELY NOT using "same_snippet": true, even though the plan specified it.  Verified cause: src/npctalk.cpp:5572 stores the chosen snippet id on d.actor(!is_npc) - the BETA talker - and both trap EOCs (src/trapfunc.cpp:506) and RECURRING global EOCs (src/effect_on_condition.cpp:172) construct their dialogue with a nullptr beta.  dialogue::actor(true) with no beta fires debugmsg("Tried to use an invalid beta talker") (src/npctalk.cpp:2706-2711) on every fire.  "same_snippet" is for EOCs where the OTHER party is an item (see data/json/items/newspaper.json); it is wrong here.
//3: THE *_again CATEGORIES are the RECURRENCE CUES (M3): a world that has already been through SCP-087 (scp_087_archive == 1) plays these instead of the first-time lines above, so a later visit reads as recognition rather than replaying the same reveal.  See effects_on_condition/scp_087_seam.json.

text.text: The crying is coming from below.  It has not gotten any closer, and it has not gotten any farther.
A child is weeping, far down the shaft.  The sound does not move when you do.
Somewhere below, the crying falters, as though it has heard you listening.
The crying is steady, patient, and exactly two hundred meters away.  It has been for some time.
You realise you have been hearing the crying so long that you stopped noticing it.  It is still there.
Under your own breathing, the crying keeps its distance - patient as a drip inside a wall.
It stops when you stop.  It starts again when you move, keeping step two floors down.
It has been crying long enough that you catch yourself listening for it to take a breath.

//: THE FOUR-ISH LOOP AMBIENCE.  Fired each time the seam returns the player, before the phases bite.
//2: POOL GROWN 4 -> 8 (playtest fix, item 3).  This is the single most-repeated category in the mod: EOC_SCP_087_SEAM plays it once per loop, so a full 13-loop descent draws from it thirteen times.  The playtest heard one line four times and another three.  There is no engine-side de-dup available - u_message resolves a CATEGORY through SNIPPET.random_from_category (src/npctalk.cpp:5591), a draw with replacement, and same_snippet cannot be used here (see the header note on this file).  The pool is the lever, so it was doubled, matching scp_087_turn_again below.

text.text: The stair turns, and the dark below is exactly as deep as it was.
Thirteen steps.  The landing.  The turn.  Thirteen steps.
You have been down this flight before.  You are almost sure of it.
The same smear of paint on the same wall.  The same dished step.  You do not remember turning around.
The wall has been repainted since you last looked at it.  It is exactly the same colour.
Your footsteps come back off the wall a fraction late, as if the stair were a size too large inside.
The handrail is cold in the same three places as last time.  You count them without meaning to.
The turn is exactly where you left it.  The turn is always exactly where you left it.

//: RECURRENCE: the turn cues for a world already through SCP-087.  Same stair, but the dread is recognition now, not discovery.
//2: Pool grown 4 -> 8 for the same reason as scp_087_cry (playtest fix, item 3): this category fires once PER LOOP, so it is the most-repeated prose in the mod - a 13-loop descent draws from it thirteen times, and in the playtest a single line came back four times.  u_message has no engine-side de-dup (see this file's header note on same_snippet), so the pool size is the fix: at eight lines each one now lands about once or twice a descent.

text.text: Thirteen steps, and you knew it would be thirteen before you began to count.
The smear of paint.  You have stood on this exact step before, and you already know what is under it.
The stair turns the way you remember, and remembering is worse than being lost.
You have come back down on purpose.  The stair has not decided yet whether that is allowed.
You count the thirteen steps aloud this time, and the stair lets you finish.  That is the only change.
You know the landing before you reach it.  Knowing does not make it arrive any sooner.
Nothing here has moved since your last descent.  You are the thing that keeps coming back.
The stair is doing this on purpose, and it has stopped pretending otherwise.  So have you.
The way back is gone.  You hear knocking from the other side.
You climb back to the landing you came from.  There is no door.  There was a door.
Something knocks on the far side of a door that is no longer there, unhurried, one to two seconds apart.

//: RECURRENCE: the loop-5 reveal, second time around.  You are not surprised, which is its own kind of horror.

text.text: The way back is gone again.  You knew it would be.  You came down anyway.
You do not climb to check the door this time.  You remember that there is no door.
The knocking starts on the far side of a door that is not there, and it sounds like it has been waiting for you to notice.
You are falling upward.  The dark pours past you the wrong way.
The stairwell has finished with you.  It is very gently putting you back.

//: HALLUCINATION FLAVOUR - short, ambiguous, layered with the real cry so the player cannot tell which cues are true.

text.text: For just a heartbeat, there is a shape behind you on the stair.
There is a figure two landings down, standing perfectly still.  When you look again there is not.
A face, blank as poured plaster, is gone before you finish turning.

//: BEAT 1 - THE KNOCK.  Fired by EOC_SCP_087_DOOR_KNOCK as you walk up to the closet door, before it is opened.  Purely atmospheric: no effect, no morale, no sound in the world.
//2: Deliberately restrained.  The article's knocking is described as unhurried and patient rather than threatening, and that is the note to keep.

text.text: As you reach for the door, something knocks twice on the other side.  Slow.  Unhurried.  Patient.
Two knocks from inside the closet, a second apart, as though whoever is knocking has all the time in the world.
The door is shut, and the room behind it is shut and empty, and something in there knocks anyway - politely, twice, and then waits.

//: RECURRENCE: the knock for a world that has already been down SCP-087 (scp_087_archive 1).  Recognition instead of discovery, matching the *_again set used by the seam turn and the loop-5 reveal.

text.text: The knocking starts before you touch the handle this time.  It knows the sound of your walk.
Two knocks, unhurried, from the far side of a door you have opened before.  It has been waiting to be recognised.
You had almost stopped thinking about the knocking.  It had not stopped thinking about you.

//: BEAT 2 - THE CRY.  Fired by EOC_SCP_087_DOORWAY as you step through the open doorway, which is one step after the handle turns (see that EOC for why the beat rides the tile rather than the opening).
//2: The cry must never be positional, because the engine cannot deliver a sound from 200 m below (see the note on EOC_SCP_087_CRY).  These lines place it in prose only - 'somewhere below', 'somewhere the building does not have' - so it stays unfalsifiable.

text.text: The door swings in on concrete and dark, and nothing else at all.  Then, from below the floor, a child begins to cry.
You pull the door open.  The closet is empty - four walls, no light, no sound.  A moment later, very faint and very far down, a child is crying.
Nothing inside but cold air and the smell of old concrete.  Then the crying starts, small and patient, out of somewhere this building does not have.

//: RECURRENCE: the doorway cry, second time around.

text.text: The door opens on the same nothing as before.  You are already listening for the crying, and it does not keep you waiting.
You know what is inside, so the crying no longer surprises you.  What is left is the part where it does not stop.
Same concrete.  Same dark.  Same child crying somewhere below.  You came back anyway.
